Yes, a focused one. Auto Edit and Clipping include 4 free videos a week while your credit balance is empty — sign in with your email, no card. The counter resets every Monday, and a failed render doesn't count. Free videos work from source footage up to 30 minutes and are complete: cuts, subtitles, zooms, titles, transitions, music from your library — nothing is quietly left out, and nothing is ever watermarked, on any tier. Generating new AI content (Text-to-Video, Avatar, Podcast, Advertisement, AI b-roll, thumbnails) and publishing to social platforms run on credits.

AI generation runs on credits — buy a pack once (from €19.90) and credits never expire. Not a subscription. 1 credit = €0.01 of AI usage, and for many actions the app shows an estimated cost before you generate. Sign in to the desktop app with the same checkout email and your balance syncs automatically. Run out? Buy another pack anytime (bigger packs are best value) or top up in the app — unused balance carries over. And whenever your balance is empty, Auto Edit and Clipping stay free for 4 videos a week.

It depends on the model, length, and resolution. Rough guide: AI images from ~8 credits, generated AI video ~9 credits/sec, talking avatars ~18 credits/sec, AI voiceover ~13 credits/min. For many actions the app shows an estimate before you generate.

No. Describe the edit — Shorz handles the timeline work for you, while you stay in control via prompts and workflow choices. It also creates from scratch (Text-to-Video, Avatar, Podcast), which most traditional editors don't.

No — Shorz replaces them. Everything you'd do by hand in an editor, Shorz does automatically: cutting and trimming, subtitles, b-roll, transitions, music and sound effects, resizing to 9:16, 1:1 or 16:9, thumbnails, and export. You describe the result instead of dragging clips on a timeline. It also does what those apps can't: it generates the footage, voiceovers, avatars, and clips from long videos in the first place. No plugins, no second app, no round-trips.

Your first pack has a 7-day money-back guarantee: make your first video, and if Shorz isn't worth it, we refund the pack in full — even if you've used credits (up to 2,500, plenty for your first videos). Beyond that, unused credits are refundable within 14 days of any purchase. Email info@shorz.ai.

Yes — videos you create with Shorz credits are cleared for full commercial use and are fully yours.

Not yet. Shorz is currently available for Windows.

Create and export finished videos in Shorz (9:16 for TikTok, Shorts, and Reels; other aspect ratios for YouTube, Instagram, and more). To reach audiences in another country — especially the United States — you need distribution from that market, not just a VPN.

TikTok and Instagram weigh location signals beyond IP: SIM carrier, GPS, device locale, and device fingerprints. VPNs and proxies often fail to deliver consistent reach abroad.

TokPortal provides real, in-country TikTok and Instagram accounts on local phones with local SIMs. Pick a target country, get accounts warmed for your niche, then upload, caption, and schedule at peak local hours — published natively from that market. You keep full account ownership.

Ready to reach US audiences? Get US Accounts on TokPortal to set up localized accounts and scale from one dashboard.
